name: Google Ads
one_liner: Programmatic API (gRPC and REST) for managing Google Ads accounts, campaigns, budgets, assets and reporting.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (scope adwords) user or service-account flows. Developer tokens were sunset on 9 Sept 2026: sending one is now optional and ignored; access level attaches to the Google Cloud project owning the OAuth client or service account.
access_notes: Enabling the API gives Test access (test accounts only). Explorer (2,880 ops/day prod) via apply, may auto-upgrade; Basic (15,000/day) needs brand verification, automated review within minutes; Standard (unlimited) manual review ~10 business days. API itself is free.

buildability.rationale: Documented API with self-serve test access; production needs access-level application (Explorer/Basic quick, Standard manual). No push webhooks. Official MCP exists.

needs_human_reason: Endpoint count not measured; no push webhooks found.

evidence.quote: Developer tokens were sunset on September 9, 2026.
Basic access applications are automated and will be reviewed within minutes after brand verification and submission.
Unlimited API operations per day against both test and production accounts
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that enables LLMs and AI agents to query and manage Google Ads accounts.
